text:
mia_cs: starting a thread — i'm drafting a customer-facing priming runbook for tenants that see bursty interactive traffic. goal: reduce cold-token latency spikes, avoid renewal surprises, and give AE/CS actionable checklist.
sam_ae: love it. can you call out renewal-risk signals we should flag to account owners? e.g. >30% failed-streams or sustained latency over 500ms?
mia_cs: yes — proposed health-signal section:
- health_score = weighted(sum([error_rate, p95_latency, failed_stream_pct, token_cost_spike]))
- immediate alert if health_score > 0.6 for 2 consecutive 10m windows
alice_success: include an easy-to-run tenant snapshot command for CS to paste into a support ticket — customers hate chasing logs.
mia_cs: good call. adding a one-line snapshot and a curl example:
```
# tenant snapshot: recent 30m metrics + a sample request id
curl -s "https://console.redwood/internals/tenant_snapshot?tenant_id=<TENANT>&window=30m" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CS_TOKEN"
```
tony_sre: ops notes: recommend staggered backoff + adaptive batching config for interactive customers. defaults to include:
- client_debounce_ms: 150-300
- batch_target_tokens: 1200
- max_concurrent_streams: 30 per tenant (soft limit)
- warm_pool_size: 2-4 per critical tenant
mia_cs: also adding a short section on streaming best-practices for customers:
- prefer incremental responses (streaming) for UI latency
- client-side debounce to collapse rapid keystrokes
- limit token window for previews to reduce cost
sam_ae: what about rollout guidance? i need a safe way to flip these on without risking regressions.
mia_cs: rollout checklist:
1) create feature-flagged config in Console under tenant -> runtime -> priming
2) enable for 1% of traffic for 24h, monitor health_score
3) if stable, 10% for 6h, then 100% with 1hr close-monitor
4) fallback policy: route to compatible smaller model variant if health_score breaches 0.7
alice_success: add a short CS email snippet to align AEs and Product about the change and renewal play if latency improves.
mia_cs: added. also wiring feedback capture: one-click survey trigger post-go-live + a quick prompt set to detect regression in quality.
ops_bot: deploy scheduled: priming-runbook-v1 -> staging at 2026-07-14T09:00Z :white_check_mark:
tony_sre: small instrumentation tip: tag traces with `priming_rollout: <flag>` and `tenant_phase: pre/post` so we can run quick diffs.
sam_ae: ok, i'll review and add customer-specific thresholds for Acme and Beta tenants. thanks!
mia_cs: thanks all — i'll push the draft to https://redwood.docs/ops/playbooks/priming-runbook and ping for a final readout tomorrow. :thumbsup:
